decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding the location of the University of Puerto Rico at Aguadilla (UPRA). Document 1 (D1S1) explicitly states it is located in 'Aguadilla, Puerto Rico', while Document 2 (D2S1) explicitly states it is located in 'San Juan, Puerto Rico'. Both documents refer to the same entity (UPRA) and provide direct answers to the 'place' slot. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without external resolution, both locations are retained as supported by their respective source segments.
